007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.agent;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.SelectAIAgent;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.ExecutionStateRequest;
013import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.TeamExecutionState;
014
015/**
016 * Updates a team execution state using a database conversation identifier.
017 *
018 * <p>Set {@code SELECTAI_DB_USER}, {@code SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD},
019 * {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}, {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_NAME}, and
020 * {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_CONVERSATION_ID}. Optionally set
021 * {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_EXECUTION_STATE}; it defaults to
022 * {@code SUCCEEDED}. The database validates whether the requested state is
023 * valid for the targeted run.</p>
024 */
025public final class SetTeamExecutionStateSample {
026
027    private SetTeamExecutionStateSample() {
028    }
029
030    /**
031     * Updates and prints the result of the team state operation.
032     *
033     * @param args command-line arguments; not used
034     * @throws SelectAIException when an SDK operation fails; the process exits unsuccessfully
035     */
036    public static void main(String[] args) throws SelectAIException {
037        String teamName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_NAME");
038        String conversationId = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_CONVERSATION_ID");
039        TeamExecutionState state = TeamExecutionState.of(
040                envOrDefault("SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_EXECUTION_STATE", "SUCCEEDED"));
041        try (SelectAIAgent client = createClient()) {
042            boolean updated = client.setTeamExecutionState(teamName,
043                    ExecutionStateRequest.builder(state)
044                            .conversationId(conversationId)
045                            .build());
046            System.out.printf("Updated team %s execution state for conversation %s: %s%n",
047                    teamName, conversationId, updated);
048        }
049    }
050
051    private static SelectAIAgent createClient() throws SelectAIException {
052        return SelectAIAgent.create(DbConnectionConfig.builder()
053                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
054                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
055                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
056                .build());
057    }
058
059    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
060        String value = System.getenv(name);
061        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
062            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
063        }
064        return value;
065    }
066
067    private static String envOrDefault(String name, String defaultValue) {
068        String value = System.getenv(name);
069        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? defaultValue : value;
070    }
071}
